text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Incredible...! Incredible, amazing...! 
What a brilliant, dazzling race...!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: (So this is the Arima Kinen...!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ngh!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: (This bone-piercing chill is—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Hah!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Kris! What an overwhelming presence...! 
It's like a blizzard—)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(I'm so cold, my legs feel like giving 
up—but I... I won't...!!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~~! That was incredible to witness!! 
Especially Symboli Kris S!! Following the 
Autumn Tenno Sho with a run like this, 
she's the real deal!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Man... honestly, you've gotta admit, she's 
so cool. After seeing a run like that... 
even her bluntness feels kind of cool in 
its own way—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...You've become one, Kris S. You, too, 
are now an Umamusume who will shake an 
era—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —This is the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(...As I thought, everyone was strong. To 
stand at the pinnacle of this era... I 
need a far more absolute strength.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Greater strength. Even greater "results"—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...You're amazing, Kris.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Even in the midst of such a fierce, heated 
race... You alone remained utterly cold 
and silent—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
But... thanks to that coldness, I was able 
to realize it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The burning passion for racing inside of 
me... that makes my entire body 
tremble...!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...Our fates might part ways right here 
today. Even so—"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
What you helped me realize... I will 
continue to cherish it from now on.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's why I pray for you, too, Kris— May 
a future full of happiness await you.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Haha! Unbelievable! Looks like I was 
still underestimating Kris S's running...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Can I really not overpower her icy 
coolness and show my burning passion 
yet...?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Then what we have to do is simple— We just 
gotta get hotter, and go even crazier!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I went to greet Symboli Kris S after she 
proudly proved her strength at the Arima 
Kinen. I already knew what words I had to 
say to her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list:
Next time, let's show them even more 
absolute strength.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S's performance today has 
reaffirmed that she is an Umamusume 
capable of standing at the pinnacle of an 
era.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And that strength—will undoubtedly 
continue to send new shockwaves through 
the racing world."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To fulfill my mission— I will make Symboli 
Kris S an absolute existence. That is my 
goal.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Thanks. I... was going to say the same 
thing.
choice_data_list: I'm glad we think the same way.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer is―

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad—you're my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Receiving such straightforward words out 
of the blue caught me a little off guard. 
But right away, a warm feeling of joy 
welled up inside my chest—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the final battle of the Classic year 
concluded, Symboli Kris S and I begin 
stepping forward into a brand new stage—
